bounded_claims: GraphRAG advantage is bounded to one task family, eleven wordings, one local model, one graph/corpus snapshot, and a bounded deterministic evaluator.
RQ2 planning evidence is bounded to one accepted paired symbolic fire-hydrant scenario.
RQ3 establishes technical auditability under encoded controls, not intrinsic LLM trust or institutional trust.
Repository-addressable deterministic verification is reproducible; live probabilistic reruns remain environment-dependent.
out_of_scope_claims: Changing KG, retrieval, model, mapping, constraint, proposal, authorization, verification, provenance, or authoritative-data semantics.
Production source mutation or authoritative final cartographic rendering.
DEMO-PUBLIC-00 implementation, deployment, public URL creation, or demo UI improvement.
PKI, trusted timestamping, key lifecycle, revocation, legal policy, or institutional authorization.
supported_claims: GraphRAG improved measured grounded mapping reasoning over the two tested baselines in the frozen portrayal task family.
Knowledge-derived geographic and cartographic constraints changed the RQ2 plan before execution and produced the only semantically executable proposal.
Bounded unresolved constraints can be preserved explicitly rather than guessed.
The validated canonical RQ2 proposal serves as a deterministic execution contract for RQ3.
Hash-bound authorization prevented the tested proposal, scope, tool, and parameter substitutions.
Deterministic postcondition verification detected the tested unacceptable execution results.
Content-addressed provenance made the canonical action reconstructable and the tested tampering detectable.
All frozen RQ3 invalid and tampered paths failed closed under their expected acceptance rules.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Fixed model/digest/config, frozen prompts and variants, raw outputs, repeats, and deterministic downstream validators.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Free-form answers and plans may vary even at temperature zero.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Byte-identical live LLM reproduction is not guaranteed.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Explicit 8192 context, output reserve, no-truncation guard, graph-ID leakage audit, and matched Text-RAG/GraphRAG evidence-token ceiling.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Delivery defects or leakage could be mistaken for architecture effects.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Representation and orchestration complexity still differ across conditions.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Persisted negative cases, independent postcondition checks, schema validation, and source-hash checks.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: A common implementation error could pass multiple stages.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Components are not institutionally or implementation-team independent.
threats_to_validity.threat: Shared contracts between planner, validator, executor, and verifier

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Six frozen semantic requirements, separate grounding/coverage checks, and retained raw answers/claims.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Scores may not capture all mapping knowledge or linguistic correctness.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Some valid semantic equivalents remain under-recognized.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Evidence-to-constraint-to-plan trace, semantic preconditions, isolated execution, and explicit postconditions.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: A compliant proposal may be non-optimal or miss an unencoded cartographic concern.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: The experiment cannot validate constraints that were never encoded.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Explicit trust-control matrix and exclusion of production/institutional claims.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Authorization, verification, and provenance could be overread as legal or institutional trust.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Human policy correctness and governance remain untested.
threats_to_validity.threat: Technical controls as a proxy for trust

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: All scenario, model, graph, schema, and data identities are frozen and declared.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Results may not transfer to other tasks, agencies, models, or datasets.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: No cross-model, cross-domain, production-user, or national-scale replication exists.
threats_to_validity.threat: Narrow scenario, controlled source data, and one model

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Authoritative source hash is checked before/after and the claim is explicitly bounded to derived output.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Success may not transfer to production GIS mutation or final rendering.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Topology, raster, conflation, multi-feature edits, and physical portrayal remain untested.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Exact denominators, effect metrics, negative cases, and bounded verdict rules are reported.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: PASS classifications may be mistaken for population-level statistical proof.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: No inferential confidence interval or broad population claim is justified.
threats_to_validity.threat: Small sample and mixed quantitative/qualitative evidence

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: RQ2 A-G and RQ3 A-L include explicit failure taxonomies and expected outcomes.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: The set is not exhaustive and does not establish general cybersecurity.

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Central controlled outputs, protocols, fixtures, schemas, reports, and hashes are committed.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: Independent live reruns may differ or cannot reconstruct every temporary byte.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: External runtime/hardware remains necessary for probabilistic regeneration.
threats_to_validity.threat: Local Ollama/model and transient auxiliary live artifacts

threats_to_validity.existing_mitigation: Exact-predecessor counts and failure classification are recorded without rewriting historical tests.
threats_to_validity.potential_impact: New failures could be confused with frozen scope assertions.
threats_to_validity.residual_risk: Broad suites remain non-green and require predecessor-relative interpretation.

unsupported_claims: Universal LLM superiority or universal GraphRAG superiority across mapping tasks.
Zero hallucination or correctness of every fact in the knowledge graph.
General-purpose autonomous GIS competence or safe arbitrary tool use.
Production infrastructure security, resistance to every cyberattack, or general AI safety.
Correctness of human authorization policy, legal acceptability, institutional governance validity, or production non-repudiation.
National-scale operational performance, arbitrary dataset scalability, or semantic correctness outside the frozen domain.
